reviewScope: Actual same-session review of the four whole abstracts and their saved initial entity/candidate inventories after generation; not independent human gold or model-based relabeling.

reviews.reason: Re-read the whole RACE abstract and all six initial spans. Three RACE source mentions are named benchmark occurrences; URL substrings are excluded. Two reading comprehension occurrences and final machine comprehension are computational tasks, while student ability and bare reasoning skills are educational context, not extra model tasks. The 43% unnamed state-of-the-art models cannot be turned into a named METHOD; zero candidate pairs is real within the schema, not fabricated negative training.

Re-read all ten TriviaQA spans and sixteen typed candidate pairs. Four TriviaQA mentions and SQuAD are named datasets. Feature-based classifier and neural network denote the two specific local baseline families, not generic unnamed models; neural network's singular SQuAD performance clause supports that family evaluation and reading-comprehension use only, not the classifier-SQuAD pair. The 23%/40% versus 80% passage explicitly compares the two approaches on the locally named TriviaQA testbed, supporting the two final-TriviaQA evaluation assertions. Their performance numbers are not imported as model confidence or independent tests of every occurrence. Twelve unjudged pairs stay unresolved, including classifier-SQuAD; lack of its measurement is not negative evidence.

Re-read the whole HotpotQA abstract and eight spans. Question answering and five QA abbreviations name the same task across local task-modifier occurrences; the HotpotQA suffix is not a standalone QA hit. Both HotpotQA occurrences are DATASET. Generic QA systems/models are not identifiable METHOD names; Wikipedia describes source documents, not a benchmark evaluation target. The title-only multi-hop phrase is not copied into the abstract. No method endpoint exists, so zero scoped pairs is not a blanket NO_RELATION claim.

Re-read the whole DROP abstract and eleven spans. Preserve English reading comprehension's language qualifier without overlapping the shorter inner literal. The capitalized Discrete Reasoning Over the content of Paragraphs is introduced with which requires as a computational objective, not a second dataset identity. Addition/counting/sorting explicitly operate on question/paragraph operands; semantic parsing and numerical reasoning name technical tasks, not method products or bare educational domains. The source gives only unnamed state-of-the-art systems/new model, despite 32.7%/47.0% scores, so do not invent METHOD endpoints or evaluation edges. DROP itself is one named DATASET. Ambiguity of generic model performance remains outside the typed candidate inventory, not negative labels.
